analogy.rationale: AR is expressed at low levels in most of these cell lines (prostate lines PC3 and VCAP are AR-negative or low), so AR modulators should produce little transcriptional response; the closest analogs are other nuclear receptor ligands, especially AR antagonist itself, with weaker similarity to other steroid receptor classes.
